156727595.description: 13-Methoxy-LSD is a lysergamide related to lysergic acid diethylamide .

164000299.name: Tilmetamine
164000299.description: Tilmetamine is a dissociative drug of the arylcyclohexylamine family related to tiletamine.

167713195.name: Leritrelvir
167713195.description: Leritrelvir is an antiviral drug which acts as a 3C-like protease inhibitor. It was developed and approved in China for treatment of COVID-19.

167713707.name: Neodymium nickelate
167713707.description: Neodymium nickelate is a nickelate of neodymium with a chemical formula NdNiO3. In this compound, the neodymium atom is in the +3 oxidation state.

900000043.name: 2CT-5-EtO
900000043.description: 2CT-5-EtO, also known as 2-methoxy-4-methylthio-5-ethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, 2C, and TWEETIO families related to 2C-T.

900000171.name: Ancestim
900000171.description: Ancestim is a recombinant methionyl human stem cell factor, branded by Amgen as StemGen.

900000299.name: Blosozumab
900000299.description: Blosozumab binds SOST, a negative regulator of osteoblast activity.

900000427.name: CboK7
900000427.description: CboK7, also known as α-KTx 2.24, is a toxin produced by a species of scorpion, Centruroides bonito. It blocks voltage-gated K+ channels, with the highest affinity for Kv1.2 channels.

900000555.name: DTwP-HepB-Hib vaccine
900000555.description: DTwP-HepB-Hib vaccine is a 5-in-1 combination vaccine with five individual vaccines conjugated into one.

900000683.name: Edobacomab
900000683.description: Edobacomab, codenamed E5, is a mouse monoclonal antibody that was investigated as a possible treatment for sepsis caused by Gram-negative bacterial infections.

900000811.name: Favezelimab
900000811.description: Favezelimab is an experimental anti-cancer monoclonal antibody developed by Merck. It is being tested by itself and in a fixed-dose combination with pembrolizumab.

900000939.name: Hexaborane(12)
900000939.description: Hexaborane is an inorganic compound with the formula B6H12.

900001067.name: Jojoba alcohol
900001067.description: Jojoba alcohol is the alcohol fraction obtained by the saponification of jojoba oil from the seeds of Simmondsia chinensis. Jojoba alcohol is commonly used in cosmetic formulations.

900001195.name: MAL-LAD
900001195.description: MAL-LAD, or MALLAD, also known as METAL-LAD or METALLAD, as well as 6-methallyl-6-nor-LSD, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide .

900001451.name: PEDOT-TMA
900001451.description: Poly -tetramethacrylate or PEDOT-TMA is a p-type conducting polymer based on 3,4-ethylenedioxylthiophene or the EDOT monomer.

900001579.name: Plutonium(III) oxide
900001579.description: Plutonium oxide is an inorganic compound of plutonium and oxygen with the chemical formula Pu2O3.

900001707.name: Praseodymium(III) molybdate
900001707.description: Praseodymium molybdate is a salt of praseodymium and molybdic acid with the chemical formula Pr2 3. It forms crystals that are insoluble in water.

900001963.name: Tafasitamab

900002091.name: Tung oil
900002091.description: Tung oil or China wood oil is a drying oil obtained by pressing the seed from the nut of the tung tree .

900002219.name: Α-Bungarotoxin
900002219.description: α-Bungarotoxin is one of the bungarotoxins, components of the venom of the elapid Taiwanese banded krait snake .
